    <script id="conectate-header-script">
    (() => {
      'use strict';
      function initializeHeader() {
        const header = document.getElementById('ct-site-header');
        if (!header) return;
        const row = header.querySelector('.ct-header-row');
        const nav = header.querySelector('.ct-navigation');
        const list = nav.querySelector('.ct-menu') || nav.querySelector('ul');
        const toggle = header.querySelector('.ct-mobile-toggle');
        const search = header.querySelector('.ct-search');
        const searchToggle = search.querySelector('summary');
        const narrow = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)');
        const groups = [];
        const chevron = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4"/></svg>';

        if (list) {
          list.classList.add('ct-menu');
          Array.from(list.children).forEach((item, index) => {
            const link = item.querySelector(':scope > a');
            const submenu = item.querySelector(':scope > ul');
            if (!link || !submenu) return;
            item.classList.toggle('ct-wide', submenu.children.length >= 7);

            const button = document.createElement('button');
            button.type = 'button';
            button.className = 'ct-menu-trigger';
            submenu.id = 'ct-header-submenu-' + index;
            button.setAttribute('aria-controls', submenu.id);
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            const href = link.getAttribute('href');
            if (!href || href === '#') {
              while (link.firstChild) button.append(link.firstChild);
              button.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', chevron);
              link.replaceWith(button);
            } else {
              item.classList.add('ct-split');
              button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Submenú de ' + link.textContent.trim());
              button.innerHTML = chevron;
              link.after(button);
            }

            const group = { item, button };
            groups.push(group);
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
              const open = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true';
              search.open = false;
              groups.forEach((other) => setGroup(other, other === group && open));
            });
          });
        }

        function setGroup(group, open) {
          group.item.classList.toggle('ct-open', open);
          group.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
        }

        function setMobileMenu(open) {
          header.toggleAttribute('data-menu-open', open);
          toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
          toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Cerrar menú' : 'Abrir menú');
          if (!open) groups.forEach((group) => setGroup(group, false));
        }

        function updateLayout() {
          const wasCompact = header.hasAttribute('data-compact');
          header.removeAttribute('data-compact');
          const compact = narrow.matches || Boolean(list && list.getBoundingClientRect().width > nav.clientWidth + 1);
          header.toggleAttribute('data-compact', compact);
          if (wasCompact !== compact) setMobileMenu(false);
        }

        toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
          search.open = false;
          setMobileMenu(toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true');
        });

        search.addEventListener('toggle', () => {
          if (!search.open) return;
          setMobileMenu(false);
          search.querySelector('input').focus();
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          if (!header.contains(event.target)) {
            search.open = false;
            setMobileMenu(false);
          }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
          if (event.key !== 'Escape' || !header.contains(event.target)) return;
          const openGroup = groups.find(({ button }) => button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true');
          if (search.open) {
            event.preventDefault();
            search.open = false;
            searchToggle.focus();
          } else if (openGroup) {
            setGroup(openGroup, false);
            openGroup.button.focus();
          } else if (toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
            setMobileMenu(false);
            toggle.focus();
          }
        });

        header.setAttribute('data-ready', '');
        updateLayout();
        // The content is a sibling, so share the measured height on their parent.
        const syncContentOffset = () => {
          header.parentElement.style.setProperty('--ct-header-height', header.offsetHeight + 'px');
        };
        syncContentOffset();
        if ('ResizeObserver' in window) {
          new ResizeObserver(updateLayout).observe(row);
          new ResizeObserver(syncContentOffset).observe(header);
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', syncContentOffset, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('resize', updateLayout, { passive: true });
        if (document.body.classList.contains('admin-bar')) {
          const syncAdminBar = () => {
            const bar = document.getElementById('wpadminbar');
            if (bar) header.style.top = Math.max(0, bar.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) + 'px';
          };
          syncAdminBar();
          window.addEventListener('scroll', syncAdminBar, { passive: true });
          window.addEventListener('resize', syncAdminBar, { passive: true });
        }
      }

      if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeHeader, { once: true });
      } else {
        initializeHeader();
      }
    })();

    <script id="conectate-header-script">
    (() => {
      'use strict';
      function initializeHeader() {
        const header = document.getElementById('ct-site-header');
        if (!header) return;
        const row = header.querySelector('.ct-header-row');
        const nav = header.querySelector('.ct-navigation');
        const list = nav.querySelector('.ct-menu') || nav.querySelector('ul');
        const toggle = header.querySelector('.ct-mobile-toggle');
        const search = header.querySelector('.ct-search');
        const searchToggle = search.querySelector('summary');
        const narrow = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)');
        const groups = [];
        const chevron = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4"/></svg>';

        if (list) {
          list.classList.add('ct-menu');
          Array.from(list.children).forEach((item, index) => {
            const link = item.querySelector(':scope > a');
            const submenu = item.querySelector(':scope > ul');
            if (!link || !submenu) return;
            item.classList.toggle('ct-wide', submenu.children.length >= 7);

            const button = document.createElement('button');
            button.type = 'button';
            button.className = 'ct-menu-trigger';
            submenu.id = 'ct-header-submenu-' + index;
            button.setAttribute('aria-controls', submenu.id);
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            const href = link.getAttribute('href');
            if (!href || href === '#') {
              while (link.firstChild) button.append(link.firstChild);
              button.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', chevron);
              link.replaceWith(button);
            } else {
              item.classList.add('ct-split');
              button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Submenú de ' + link.textContent.trim());
              button.innerHTML = chevron;
              link.after(button);
            }

            const group = { item, button };
            groups.push(group);
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
              const open = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true';
              search.open = false;
              groups.forEach((other) => setGroup(other, other === group && open));
            });
          });
        }

        function setGroup(group, open) {
          group.item.classList.toggle('ct-open', open);
          group.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
        }

        function setMobileMenu(open) {
          header.toggleAttribute('data-menu-open', open);
          toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
          toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Cerrar menú' : 'Abrir menú');
          if (!open) groups.forEach((group) => setGroup(group, false));
        }

        function updateLayout() {
          const wasCompact = header.hasAttribute('data-compact');
          header.removeAttribute('data-compact');
          const compact = narrow.matches || Boolean(list && list.getBoundingClientRect().width > nav.clientWidth + 1);
          header.toggleAttribute('data-compact', compact);
          if (wasCompact !== compact) setMobileMenu(false);
        }

        toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
          search.open = false;
          setMobileMenu(toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true');
        });

        search.addEventListener('toggle', () => {
          if (!search.open) return;
          setMobileMenu(false);
          search.querySelector('input').focus();
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          if (!header.contains(event.target)) {
            search.open = false;
            setMobileMenu(false);
          }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
          if (event.key !== 'Escape' || !header.contains(event.target)) return;
          const openGroup = groups.find(({ button }) => button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true');
          if (search.open) {
            event.preventDefault();
            search.open = false;
            searchToggle.focus();
          } else if (openGroup) {
            setGroup(openGroup, false);
            openGroup.button.focus();
          } else if (toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
            setMobileMenu(false);
            toggle.focus();
          }
        });

        header.setAttribute('data-ready', '');
        updateLayout();
        // The content is a sibling, so share the measured height on their parent.
        const syncContentOffset = () => {
          header.parentElement.style.setProperty('--ct-header-height', header.offsetHeight + 'px');
        };
        syncContentOffset();
        if ('ResizeObserver' in window) {
          new ResizeObserver(updateLayout).observe(row);
          new ResizeObserver(syncContentOffset).observe(header);
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', syncContentOffset, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('resize', updateLayout, { passive: true });
        if (document.body.classList.contains('admin-bar')) {
          const syncAdminBar = () => {
            const bar = document.getElementById('wpadminbar');
            if (bar) header.style.top = Math.max(0, bar.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) + 'px';
          };
          syncAdminBar();
          window.addEventListener('scroll', syncAdminBar, { passive: true });
          window.addEventListener('resize', syncAdminBar, { passive: true });
        }
      }

      if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeHeader, { once: true });
      } else {
        initializeHeader();
      }
    })();
    </script>
